Lessons.Text: Short obby stages with a checkpoint every few jumps keep new players going.
A thumbnail showing the lava and the finish together gets about 5% click-through for obbies.
A 149 Robux VIP pass sold poorly in a three-stage obby; offer cheaper boosts first.
Players who clear stage 2 of an obby tend to stay five minutes or more.
Lessons.Evidence: telemetry: 214 sessions, median 5.6 min; 62% reach stage 2
